verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents API calls that let an agent create purchase objects. Agent Checkouts takes a product URL plus a spending cap and starts a poll-driven checkout run. Order intents can be created and authorized, and the headless checkout REST APIs create orders. Nothing in the evidence shows creating a multi-item cart or updating an order draft, and the checkout flow is a single-shot run rather than an editable draft. Missing for 10: documented cart/draft update calls, multi-item cart construction, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration.
